class.name: OpenWorldTreeGenerator3D
class.brief_description: Generates a deterministic, static stylized tree mesh in the editor or at run time.
class.description: [OpenWorldTreeGenerator3D] builds a low-poly trunk and phyllotactic branches from [member generation_profile], then creates an archetype-specific crown. Broadleaf, tropical, umbrella, conifer, and mangrove trees use shaped canopy blobs; palm trees use radial curved ribbon fronds. Tropical and mangrove archetypes can also generate buttress or prop roots. The result is one [ArrayMesh] with trunk/branch surface 0 and foliage surface 1. Generation is deterministic for the same profile and [member seed]. Use the Inspector actions to regenerate, randomize the seed, or bake the current result into an [OpenWorldTreeVariant] resource. The baked resource can be added to an [OpenWorldTreeSpecies] and rendered by [OpenWorldTree3D]. This phase does not generate LOD1/LOD2 meshes, collisions, wind animation, leaf cards, or cut fragments.

method.name: clear_generated_tree
method.description: Clears the generated [ArrayMesh] from this node.

method.name: create_baked_variant
method.description: Creates an unsaved variant containing a deep copy of the current mesh as LOD0. Call [method generate_tree] first.

method.name: generate_tree
method.description: Rebuilds the static mesh from [member generation_profile] and [member seed], and emits [signal tree_generated].

method.name: get_generated_mesh
method.description: Returns the currently generated mesh, or [code]null[/code] before generation or after clearing.

method.name: randomize_seed
method.description: Chooses a random seed and generates a new variation.

members.member: Regenerates when the profile or seed changes and generates on entering the scene tree if needed.
Shared tree-shape parameters. Duplicate the resource before editing it when generators should not update together.
Material embedded on trunk and branch surface 0.

signal.name: tree_generated
signal.description: Emitted after a new two-surface mesh is assigned to the node.
